fixture_conventions.rule: use bounded literal or deterministically generated byte arrays; never commit raw captures or device identifiers
name the algorithm profile, seed, input bytes, and expected result; a textbook vector cannot become firmware authority
use test-owned counters and deterministic barriers; wall-clock sleeps are not completion evidence
generate minimal files below a test-owned temporary directory with documentation-only addresses and no credentials
check sizeof, alignof, and offsetof against an explicitly named compiler, platform, and data model
bind loopback with test-assigned ephemeral ports; never embed private network identities or infer physical qualification
create unique paths below the platform temporary directory, assert cleanup, and never embed a developer absolute path
use fakes and explicit barriers to prove registration, removal, shutdown, and callback counts without hardware
inject fixed clocks and explicit zones; do not depend on the host clock, locale, or timezone
